# UPchieve Changelog, week of Aug 15 to Aug 22, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Aug 20, subway Aug 20. These deploys carried the assignment-upload and secret-scanning backlogs that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Enforce one chapter per school.** Founding a chapter now writes an `UNAFFILIATED` affiliation row whenever the application carries a real `school_id`, so the existing unique-school constraint does the enforcing, and approving a candidate is refused outright when their school already belongs to a chapter or to another approved-but-not-yet-founded applicant. An application with only a hand-typed school name and no id still creates no affiliation row, so any number of unconfirmed-school chapters can coexist. The advisor form drops the school picker when the chapter's school is already on record, and a 422 from create-chapter shows the server's message instead of "Unknown error, please try again", which most often means another chapter already covers that school. ([subway !2867](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2867), [subway !2868](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2868); [high-line !1849](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1849)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Open the NTHS learn-more doc in preview mode.** The link pointed at `/edit`, so students got the Docs editor's "Request edit access" banner instead of the document. ([high-line !1852](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1852)) *Ben Wheeler*
- **The application form itself now lives in the app.** 🧪 the form, its routes, and the POST endpoint behind it, rolled out to no one yet ([`nths-application-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/593343)) ([high-line !1809](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1809); [subway !2834](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2834)); 🚀 the columns holding the questions and answers, the name, city, state, and website of a school we could not match, the question-set version, and separate decided and activated timestamps so an approval can be held back and revealed later ([subway !2833](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2833)); 🚀 `RETURNING *` dropped from the candidate-application insert, which names its six columns now, so the new nullable columns do not reach the row mapper ([subway !2864](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2864)). Whether someone can apply is a server check now rather than the `user-is-approved-nths-president` flag, which used to stand in for it and would have offered a button the API refuses. Approving and denying still happens in the Retool admin, which has no update endpoint yet. *Kasozi Wilson, Ben Wheeler*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- **Let a coach share a few facts about themselves with the student mid-session.** 🧪 the coach picks which of their occupation, sessions tutored, students tutored, and hours tutored to share, and the student gets a "Learn more about your coach" toggle on the partner panel, with the message relayed over a new socket event to everyone in the session room except the sender ([subway !2861](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2861); [high-line !1841](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1841)); 🧪 impression events for the coach seeing the opt-in modal and the student seeing the toggle, so the click and opt-out events have a denominator ([high-line !1845](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1845)); 🚀 the student side of the panel stopped checking the flag, so any student paired with a coach who shared something sees it ([high-line !1853](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1853)); ✅ the opt-in modal no longer closes on a click outside it, since we do not want to give coaches the chance to skip answering, and its Back button works on mobile ([high-line !1856](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1856)). The coach's opt-in modal reaches 20% of the "Volunteers" cohort ([`show-volunteer-opt-in-to-share-info`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/823424)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Students send a college essay in and get written feedback on it, outside a live session.** Staff doing the reviews and hand-writing the email back took enough time that it capped how long the experiment could run, so coaches take the reviewing over. Rolled out to no one yet ([`async-essay-review`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/806269)): 🧪 a required third step on the submission form, "Where should we send your feedback?", since several school addresses have bounced, with the admin detail page showing that address alongside the account email ([subway !2857](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2857); [high-line !1838](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1838)); 🧪 the same offer made from the Journeys view and from the AI tutor's transfer-to-session step, when the topic is college essays ([high-line !1837](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1837)); ✅ a review page coaches reach from a dashboard card, listing submissions from the past 24 hours, taking up to six reviews each, and posting to Slack through a PostHog webhook on every review so staff can spot a submission that has reached three ([high-line !1854](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1854)); 👀 the backend behind that page ([subway !2871](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2871)); ✅ an admin emailing up to three coach reviews to the student from a template instead of writing it by hand ([subway !2872](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2872)); 👀 the admin page for it ([high-line !1855](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1855)); ✅ coaches emailed when a student submits an essay, with a link straight to the review page, if they opt in ([subway !2873](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2873)). *Trey Stevens, Liseidy Bueno*
- ✅ **Screen image uploads with PhotoDNA before they are stored.** [#658](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/658): the moderation-infraction reads moved from `makeRequired` to `makeSomeRequired`, which splits the migration and the code into separate MRs. ([subway !2831](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2831)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **A Vuetify form checkbox**, continuing the move of the component library onto Vuetify. ([high-line !1741](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1741)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Bring AWS storage into Pulumi.** None of our AWS resources are defined in Pulumi today; the new `storage` project will hold the S3 buckets and their permissions, with Azure storage to follow. The GCS root became a pnpm workspace first, so dependency versions come from a shared catalog instead of being declared, and remembered, in every subproject. ([GCS !191](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/191), [GCS !192](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/192)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Upload the files a teacher attaches when editing an assignment.** The edit modal accepted attachments and dropped them, because the upload was a separate request from the assignment update. 🐛 [#653](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/653): one `upsertAssignment` query behind both create and edit ([subway !2830](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2830)); a `PUT /assignment` endpoint on top of it ([subway !2835](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2835)); a separate endpoint for assigning to multiple classes, since the old one assigned the selected students even when they were not in the class, so a teacher saw students on an assignment who were not in it ([subway !2829](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2829)); the file upload folded into the backend upsert ([subway !2837](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2837)); a check that the teacher owns the class or assignment, which any teacher could previously edit ([subway !2836](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2836)); the now-unused assignment methods and routes removed ([subway !2838](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2838)); an `AssignmentService` on the front end, since creating from the teacher dashboard had diverged and skipped the upload ([high-line !1805](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1805)); the service pointed at the new endpoints ([high-line !1811](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1811)); the upload folded into the service's upsert request ([high-line !1812](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1812)); the views switched over to the service ([high-line !1806](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1806)); and the modal held open under a loading overlay while the request runs, so a failure no longer closes it and discards the teacher's work ([high-line !1813](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1813)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Send the national tutoring certificate email on the same criteria that let you download the certificate.** You could download it after your first session, but the email telling you to go get it only went out once you finished onboarding and got certified in a subject, so the two never lined up. 🐛 [#697](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/697) ([subway !2866](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2866)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Count a coach's sessions by the role they played in them.** `getSessionUsers` was written when a user had one role, so for an S2V account the sessions they coached and the sessions they attended as a student came back pooled, and the Impact Summary card read the wrong numbers off `pastSessions`. Both now come from the role-aware user props. 🐛 [#698](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/698) ([subway !2865](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2865); [high-line !1848](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1848)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Let the math keyboard's layout switcher stay on screen in abc mode.** The container is a fixed 218px box, MathLive's keyboard fills it with `overflow: hidden` and anchors its backdrop to the bottom, so a taller layout gets clipped from the top, which is exactly where the switcher sits. Numeric, symbols, and greek fit; alphabetic has a fifth row and needs 262px, so only `abc` trapped you. The keyboard came out of absolute positioning so the container grows to whichever layout is active. A larger `min-height` would not work, because MathLive scales keycap height across four breakpoints keyed off container width and viewport height. 🐛 [#696](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/696) ([high-line !1847](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1847)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Connect the chat in the session recap on mobile.** `SessionChat` never got its props updated for the mobile-mode viewport width, in an MR from over a year ago, so the recap sat on "Attempting to connect the chat". 🐛 [#695](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/695) ([high-line !1843](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1843)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Make the whole session-history row clickable on mobile, with a hover state.** Nataly reported having to tap the caret twice to reach the session recap; the caret's click area was just too small for a target that size. 🐛 [#695](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/695) ([high-line !1846](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1846)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Stop the console error for a student with no favorite volunteers.** `favoriteVolunteers` comes back optional from subway; spotted in the browser console of a session replay. ([high-line !1842](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1842)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- **Move secret scanning to push time and off `detect-secrets`.** `detect-secrets` rewrote `.secrets.baseline` every time it ran, so the drift landed in the MR alongside the real changes, and it only ever looked at the current state of changed files, which misses a secret that was committed and then removed. Betterleaks scans a range of commits instead, which is what a push needs, and there is no baseline file. 🚀 a version-controlled `.githooks` directory replacing the `pre-commit` package, which only ever wrote `.git/hooks/pre-commit` and did not support pre-push at all ([subway !2858](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2858)); 🚀 Betterleaks behind the pre-commit and pre-push hooks ([subway !2859](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2859)); 🚀 `secrets:check` moved onto pre-push ([subway !2860](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2860)); 🚀 a `bin/jj_pre_push` so jj users get the pre-push hooks too, since jj has no hook system, invoked through a shell shim they add themselves ([subway !2862](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2862)); 👀 the same four changes on high-line, split by commit to match ([high-line !1851](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1851)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Stop the intermittent "Failed to fetch dynamically imported module" failures in the unit tests.** `MazPhoneNumberInput` lazily imports its country flags from a CDN, so the volunteer-signup spec now stubs `MazLazyImg`, and `vuetify/components/VIcon` joined the vite deps-optimize list. ([high-line !1844](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1844)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Let `PGHOST`/`PGPORT` point the db scripts at another database.** The `db:` scripts, `reset_db.sh`, and `.pgpass` hardcoded `localhost:5432`, so with two checkouts running, a migration from the second one quietly landed in the first one's database. `.pgpass` had the port hardcoded too, so it silently failed to authenticate anywhere but 5432 and now wildcards it. Defaults are unchanged. ([subway !2852](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2852)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🎁 **Allow the dev photo-ID and session-photo buckets through the content security policy.** `dev-photo-ids` and `dev-session-photos` were added to `connect-src` and `img-src`, and the region-less `upc-*` bucket URLs came out of `img-src` in the report-only header, to confirm through reporting that every URL really does carry its region. ([high-line !1857](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1857)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Stop the axios response interceptor from destroying network errors.** The interceptor in `router.ts` reads `error.response.data` with no guard, and axios only sets `response` when one actually arrived, so on an offline, timeout, dropped, or cancelled request the interceptor throws while inspecting the error and its own TypeError replaces the real one. It has been doing that for over two years: downstream checks fall through to their generic branch, `isAxiosError` goes false, the places that surface `err.message` show users raw JS, and New Relic records one anonymous TypeError instead of the failure. The error now returns untouched when there is no response. Network-failure volume in New Relic will look like it jumps; it was already happening. ([high-line !1858](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1858)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Keep the whiteboard toolbar and back-to-chat button on screen in landscape.** A student who opened the whiteboard and rotated lost both, with no way back to chat. The full-screen override sat on the canvas itself at a high z-index and painted over the toolbar, and the toggle button was gated on `mobileMode`, so it never rendered on phones wider than that in landscape, which is most modern phones. The override moved up to the whiteboard wrapper, and a width-independent `isCompactLandscape` check replaces the width-only one, so short landscape gets the same single-pane layout as mobile at any width. ([high-line !1761](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1761)) *Iulia Rontu*
- 👀 **Pass the `EmailSessionReported` job the data it needs.** `processSessionEnded` queued it with the arguments in the wrong positions, so `sessionId` and `userId` arrived undefined and the job failed in `asString`. TypeScript missed it because `JSON.parse` returns `any`. The report data also stopped being written with an expiration, since it gets removed from the cache once it is used and `processSessionEnded` has run more than a day late before, which would have dropped the notification. ([subway !2874](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2874)) *Alex Lindsay*
